name: Groundfast Thrust
description: Set both feet and drive the spear straight along the shaft line into the foe's chest.

name: Plinthed Longshaft
description: Turn the shaft across the body to knock a blow wide while the feet hold their ground.

name: Puissant Pushthrough
description: Slide the rear hand up the haft to lengthen the thrust past the foe's guard.

name: Muscled Beatback
description: Snap the butt of the shaft into the foe's lead foot to halt an advance.

name: Weightbearing Collarband
description: Plant the spear upright before the body and spread qi down the shaft to bar a charge.

name: Broadbacked Twirl
description: Sweep the long shaft in a low flat circle that cuts down every foe within the spear's length.

name: Tendoned Bindcord
description: Drive the spearhead through the foe's guard into the ground and pin the weapon there.

name: Hewn Heelspike
description: Advance one heavy pace at a time while the shaft keeps the foe's blade pressed aside.

name: Boulderlike Spearpoint
description: Bring the spear down from overhead and drive it through guard and armor in one heavy lunge.

name: Rockhard Bladewings
description: Root both legs and the shaft so a heavy blow breaks against the stance and rebounds.

name: Fibrous Slideshaft
description: Cross the gap behind a leveled spear in one rush that lands the point as the body stops.

name: Monumental Leafhead
description: Gather weight and qi into one thrust that passes through the first rank and into the second.

name: Stoic Socket
description: Drive the shaft into the earth and hold the line with qi until what stands behind it is safe.

name: Colossean Stretch
description: Bring the spear down with the whole reserve in one blow that levels all before it to the tier's destructive ceiling.

name: Straining Ferrule
description: Thrust through everything on one line at the tier's destructive ceiling and leave a furrow where the line ran.

name: Unflagging Thrust
description: Set the front hand and rear hand on the shaft and drive a plain straight thrust.

name: Tireless Buttshoe
description: Drop the butt of the shaft onto the foe's foot or knee with the weight of the whole arm.

name: Hardbitten Collarband
description: Hold the shaft crosswise before the body and take the blow on the wood and the braced arms.

name: Lionhearted Heelspike
description: Close one short step with the rear foot following to keep the base wide and low.

name: Stonehanded Longshaft
description: Roll the shaft over the foe's weapon to turn it aside and stay planted.

name: Broadshouldered Bindcord
description: Lean the spear on the foe's blade and walk it aside step by step with steady qi.

name: Peaked Twirl
description: Thrust twice from one stance with the second driving where the first has opened the guard.

name: Jagged Slideshaft
description: Sweep the shaft behind the foe's lead leg to throw the stance off true.

name: Atlantean Pushthrough
description: Lunge with the whole body behind the point to punch through a raised shield or a wooden barrier.

name: Plinthed Socket
description: Stand the haft before the body and brace it with both arms and a steady flow of qi.

name: Puissant Spearpoint
description: Drive the point forward with every pound of the body behind it so the thrust cannot be turned.

name: Monumental Beatback
description: Meet a charge with the butt set in the earth and let the foe's own weight carry it onto the point.

name: Hewn Backedge
description: Raise the saber over the shoulder and bring it down in one heavy plain hewing cut.

name: Stoic Swell
description: Lay the flat and spine of the saber along the forearm to take a blow without yielding.

name: Tireless Skimmer
description: Walk forward with the saber low and each foot set down flat before the next lifts.

name: Muscled Falsedge
description: Draw the curved edge through the foe in a long pull that follows the bend of the blade.

name: Rockhard Counterguard
description: Turn the spine of the saber into the foe's blow and slide it off the blade's curve.

name: Straining Whirl
description: Drop the blade's weight on the foe's guard to break the rhythm of a combination.

name: Broadbacked Pipeback
description: Press the flat of the saber against the foe's weapon and bear down to hold it still.

name: Colossean Slantcut
description: Swing the saber in a falling arc from shoulder to hip that splits shield and guard both.

name: Weightbearing Knucklebow
description: Turn on the planted foot and cut a full circle that clears every foe within the blade's reach.

name: Peaked Spinecurve
description: Hew through plate and bone with the whole body behind one straight descending cut.

name: Stonehanded Steel Basket
description: Set the feet and bring the saber down as one stroke that fells the foe and ends where the stance ends.

name: Hardbitten Socketring
description: Lift the halberd and chop down with the axe face in one heavy stroke from the shoulder.

name: Boulderlike Axefall
description: Level the halberd and jab with the spike at the end of the haft along a straight line.

name: Fibrous Hookback
description: Brace the haft across the chest with both hands and take the blow on the shaft.

name: Lionhearted Spike
description: Catch the foe's weapon or limb behind the halberd's hook and drag it off line.

name: Atlantean Crownspike
description: Shear the haft across the foe's weapon to knock it down and open the foe's body.

name: Groundfast Axeblade
description: Swing the whole halberd flat at leg height and drive the foe back with the haft's weight.

name: Monumental Haft
description: Chop with the axe face then rip back with the hook to split a shield and pull it away.

name: Jagged Axeheel
description: Cross the haft over a held door or a narrow way and bar it with braced arms and qi.

name: Plinthed Tailstop
description: Bring the axe blade down from overhead with the full length of the haft and cleave through armor.

name: Unflagging Langet
description: Chain spike then hook then axe face in one planted sequence that ends the exchange before the foe resets.
